name: Steady Study
summary: Stable study frames and short transitions keep your place between steps and questions.

features.title: Setup stays in place
features.text: Deck and round setup keep the same frame and action positions as you move between steps.

features.title: Smooth question changes
features.text: Questions and answers slide within a stable workspace. Long content scrolls inside the card, and study controls remain available.

features.title: Steady save feedback
features.text: Saving, retry messages, and recall ratings keep their space without moving the page. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.
